lines.en: I am a single block of stone, walking.

lines.zh: 我的脚步把地砖踩出裂纹。
lines.en: My steps crack the tiles.

lines.zh: 我身上有几处石缝在响。
lines.en: Stone seams on me creak.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转身，像一堵墙在挪。
lines.en: I turn slowly, a wall in motion.
I grind forward in your direction.

lines.zh: 我一步一个坑，走得很稳。
lines.en: Each step a pit. My gait is steady.
I flatten a crate in my path.
My arms hang heavy.

lines.zh: 我走过之后，地上有石粉。
lines.en: After I pass, stone dust remains.
I stop and test the ground.

lines.zh: 我从石堆里出来，身上还挂着碎石。
lines.en: I come out of the rubble, chips still clinging.
I walk the wall's base; the wall shakes.
I stand still, like a statue.

lines.zh: 我身上的石缝里透出一点光。
lines.en: A little light shows in my seams.
I slowly close my fist.

lines.zh: 我脚下的地砖已经碎了。
lines.en: The tiles under me are already broken.
I turn my head one notch.
I am heavy, and patient.
I shudder; chips fall.
I watch the door and never move.
A layer of dust settles on me.
I listen, waiting for someone.

lines.zh: 我低下头，你才到我胸口。
lines.en: I look down; you reach my chest.
You look thin in front of me.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，石头摩擦发声。
lines.en: I raise a hand; stone grinds.

lines.zh: 我朝你走了一步，地面凹了。
lines.en: I take a step; the ground dents.
You retreat; I keep coming.
I raise both hands to my chest.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西挡不住石头。
lines.en: What you hold will not stop stone.

lines.zh: 我把你的站位看进眼里。
lines.en: I take in where you stand.
I tilt my head; light leaks from a seam.
I sink my shoulder, ready to ram.
A stone falls off me.
I lurch, then brace again.
A new crack appears on me.
A deep sound comes from me.

lines.zh: 我把掉下的碎片踢回来。
lines.en: I kick the fallen pieces back.
I shift half a step; the crack stays.
My seams dim.
The stone settles; I steady my feet.
My stride hitches, then goes on.
I raise my head; my seams still glow.
Stone has no need of your things.

lines.zh: 你把东西放下，我没有捡。
lines.en: You set it down. I do not pick it up.
I do not take that. Put it away.
I press it into the ground.

lines.zh: 它在我手里像一块小石子。
lines.en: In my hand it is a pebble.
I open my hand; it drops by my feet.
I do not bend down.
You keep it.
My gaze does not leave you.
I flick it aside to the wall's base.
You crash into me; I only rock.
I do not move at all.
As you pull back, your shoulder aches.

lines.zh: 我抬臂一拨，你滑到一边。
lines.en: I raise an arm and sweep you aside.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，声音很沉。
lines.en: We collide; the sound is deep.

lines.zh: 我脚下的砖又碎了一块。
lines.en: Another tile breaks under me.
I lower my head; my shadow covers you.
You did not move me.

lines.zh: 我侧过身，给你让出半步。
lines.en: I turn aside and give you half a step.
I pin you against the wall.
Another stone waits for me.

lines.zh: 我们并排站着，缝隙对缝隙。
lines.en: We stand side by side, seam to seam.
I carry a stone over for her.

lines.zh: 我们一起踩碎了脚下的砖。
lines.en: Together we break the tiles beneath us.
Light shows in her seams too.

lines.zh: 我们没有说话，只是站着。
lines.en: We do not speak. We only stand.
She rests a hand on my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我们一起把一面墙推倒。
lines.en: Together we push a wall down.
When she steps back, prints remain.

lines.zh: 我们各自站回自己的位置。
lines.en: Each of us returns to our place.
I take it in my whole hand.
One glance, and I toss it away.
My fingers close and it turns to powder.
It is lighter than it looks.
I set it on the rubble.
I lift my arm and hold it to the light.
It is tiny in my palm.
I press it down into the earth.
I drop it without breaking stride.
I turn it over and over.
You are standing before me.
I raise both hands.
I grind forward half a block.
The light in my seams brightens.
You cannot outrun my stride.

lines.zh: 你站的这块地砖，我记下了。
lines.en: I have marked the tile you stand on.
I wind up; my shoulders swell.

lines.zh: 墙就在你背后，退不了了。
lines.en: The wall is at your back. No retreat.

lines.zh: 我站在原地，你就跑不掉。
lines.en: I stay put, and you cannot get away.

lines.zh: 我朝你那边整个压过去。
lines.en: I bear my whole weight toward you.

lines.zh: 我喉咙里发出石头的响。
lines.en: A stone sound comes from my throat.
One step will be enough.
I tilt my head toward you.
The tiles under you are creaking.
I have already begun to move.
The brick behind you is mine as well.
I push you back, block by block.

lines.zh: 你往左，我的手已经在那儿。
lines.en: You go left; my hand is already there.
I walk slowly, but I never stop.
You cut me; only a white mark.
I crowd you into the corner.
I lift a foot; it lands as a pit.
I make no sound; I only advance.

lines.zh: 我架开你的攻击，反手砸下。
lines.en: I turn your blow aside and hammer back.

lines.zh: 你越往后退，我落手越沉。
lines.en: The farther you retreat, the heavier I strike.
All my seams are lit.

lines.zh: 我掰下一块砖，捏在手里。
lines.en: I break off a brick and grip it.
You are counting my steps.
I bend the door frame.

lines.zh: 你背后只剩半块砖的地方。
lines.en: Only half a brick of ground is left behind you.
I raise my hand; chips fall.
Every step is sure.
You are moving. I see it clearly.
Dust falls from the wall where I pass.

lines.zh: 再迈一步，我就到你面前。
lines.en: One more stride and I am at you.
This one will echo for a while.
I bring my fist down; the ground dents.
I sweep my arm and knock you aside.
I grab you and press you to the wall.

lines.zh: 我的石头肩膀撞在你胸口。
lines.en: My stone shoulder hits your chest.

lines.zh: 这一拳打偏了，砸进墙里。
lines.en: The punch misses and buries in the wall.
My foot comes down; the tiles shatter.
I pin you with my elbow.
You guard the front. Your ribs are open.
I draw my fist back half a step and raise it again.

lines.zh: 你的攻击只让我顿了一顿。
lines.en: Your hit only makes me pause.
I shove you through the door.

lines.zh: 石屑从我的手臂上崩下来。
lines.en: Chips break off my arm.
My fist is still up.
The blow puts you back three steps.
I fling the rubble at you.
You land in the broken tiles.
I bear down; the tiles sink.

lines.zh: 我没有呼吸，只有石头摩擦。
lines.en: I have no breath, only grinding stone.
I switch hands and keep hammering.

lines.zh: 这一下之后，我退开了一步。
lines.en: After that blow, I step back.
I push up out of the broken bricks.

lines.zh: 我一块一块把自己拼好。
lines.en: I piece myself together, block by block.

lines.zh: 我第一眼看见的是裂缝。
lines.en: The first thing I see is a crack.

lines.zh: 我朝有声音的方向转头。
lines.en: I turn toward the sound.
I lift a foot; the tile cracks first.

lines.zh: 我身上的碎石落了一地。
lines.en: Rubble falls off me everywhere.
I straighten up, taller than the door.
I shudder; dust scatters.
I fix on a direction.
I slowly raise my arms.
I settle in place, steady.

lines.zh: 我朝最近的活物看过去。
lines.en: I look at the nearest living thing.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的石面，我裂得更开。
lines.en: Fire bakes my stone face; the cracks widen.
I crash down and break into pieces.

lines.zh: 水压进石缝，我挣不出来。
lines.en: Water presses into my seams; I cannot get free.
The blast bursts me apart.
An arrow shatters on my stone and bounces.

lines.zh: 那光从石缝钻进我体内。
lines.en: That light enters through my seams.

lines.zh: 没有石头可吃，我在变脆。
lines.en: No stone to take in; I am turning brittle.

lines.zh: 雷打在我头上，石缝全亮了。
lines.en: Lightning hits my crown; every seam lights.

lines.zh: 脚下的地没了，我往下坠。
lines.en: The ground is gone; I fall.
